not_verifiable: Allergens are link-only (no allergens.csv), so there are no allergen marks to compare; the linked page https://www.bettys.co.uk/allergens (the QR target) was not opened because the site sits behind a bot challenge.
notes: Calories-only chain. All 134 published items checked by eye against 110 dpi renders of PDF pages 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15 and 16 (and pdftotext for page 9): every kcal, size variant (scone with cream 515 / toasted 390, Nozeco glass 25 / bottle 150, water 330 ml / 750 ml), serving text and the (V)/(Ve) and bacon/ham/sausage/beef tags match; the dish-to-number pairing on the centred and two-column pages (coffees, Little Rascal menu, milkshakes) is right. Grande Breakfast, Soup of the Day, afternoon teas and 'kcal on request' items are correctly not published. The audit raised no flags. Note: cafetiere and tea items print 0 kcal although the menu says they are served with milk or cream; published as printed.
